text:
Preserve the current complete-manifest loops, guards, observed conditional consent, per-product visits, actual document write/output reference and root cleanup. The current revision fixes completeness, but still misuses extraction to copy typed Browser observation records and passes whole foreach outputs into consumers. Revise only this implementation; preserve accepted business requirements and unrelated work.
For each page, use its authoritative observation.records array and deterministic value/field/object bindings (copy-only foreach where necessary), not an extract transform, to construct a consumer-specific record view. Use actual declared Browser fields and their exact types/nullability; do not invent a selector field or make optional fields required by copying. Consent needs observed control text/group/role and exact selectorHints; search selection needs observed text/group/href but no selectors; product field extraction needs observed text/group/heading context, not selectors or unrelated URLs. Keep full source records available in their producer for later actions. No filtering/truncation/flattening in copy loops: preserve every record, order, duplicates and page grouping.
Export named page views and bind each consumer directly to the foreach's declared exported port; never bind the whole foreach result envelope or add the raw page alongside its view. Keep global selection of up to ten observed product links explicit as a genuine decision over compact search views, not automatic one-to-one extraction. Product-field extraction remains extract over its compact observed business view; it must not use interpretation to invent missing values. Derive missing flags through existing predicates or preserve explicit nullable result fields; do not request technical copy mappings or synthetic indices from learned extraction. One-to-one array extraction is for independent items only.
Keep required scope exports and clean references. Do not add more LLM calls solely for field-copying or wider public inputs. All limits, approval, provenance, observed visits and workbook/cleanup oracles remain unchanged.
